 Bombay Times Fashion Week Concludes Three-Day Fashion Extravaganza
BKB Editorial 
 Chief Editor 
 Last updated: Nov 4, 2026 11:31 am 
1 Min Read 
 Mumbai: Bombay Times Fashion Week concluded its three-day fashion celebration on a spectacular note, bringing together celebrated designers, leading fashion labels, emerging talent and prominent names from the entertainment industry. From glamorous celebrity showstoppers and contemporary couture to distinctive designer collections, the event celebrated the diversity and evolving creativity of Indian fashion.
 The third day continued the fashion spectacle with an equally exciting lineup. Neetu Rohra presented her collection featuring Natasha Stankovic as a showstopper and Isha Koppikar as her guest in her saree. Dapper & Dare by Vishal and Sona Thawani brought together Terence Lewis, Shivam Khajuria and Adrija Roy for its runway presentation as Showstoppers. XERF presented designer Nikhita Tandon, featuring Urvashi Rautela as the showstopper. SR Queens presents  Media Kshitij Choudhary featured Aayush Sharma, while Fuji Films presented designer Nikita Mhaisalkar, with actor Jim Sarbh as the showstopper. Adding to the grandeur of the finale, Rocky Star presented the concluding showcase, supported by Satyam Developers and Metro Group, with Malaika Arora taking centre stage as the showstopper. Her appearance brought the three-day fashion celebration to a glamorous close.
The Event also Witness The Presence of Ameesha Patel,
Celina Jaitly,Ruhi Singh,Adnan Khan, Umar Riaz, Ankkitha Maithy, 
Dolly Javed,Deepti sadhwani,Rashmi Aarya,Priyanka Bajaj Sibal, 
Siddharth Sibal, Prashant Virendra Sharma.
With an impressive mix of established designers, emerging fashion voices, celebrity appearances and runway showcases, Bombay Times Fashion Week once again brought together the worlds of fashion and entertainment, creating a memorable platform for creativity, craftsmanship and style
